content: CGO/goreleaser cross-compilation pitfalls: (1) GoReleaser does not natively support CGO — use goreleaser-cross Docker image for cross-compilation with C dependencies. (2) CGO_ENABLED defaults to ON for host target, OFF for cross-compile targets — this inconsistency causes subtle behavior differences; always set explicitly. (3) fetch-depth: 1 in GitHub Actions breaks goreleaser changelog — use fetch-depth: 0. (4) Hidden CGO dependencies (e.g., go-sqlite3) silently produce stub packages when CGO_ENABLED=0 — build succeeds but functionality is missing. (5) Windows arm64 + CGO is extremely hard — use native runner or MinGW-w64; consider dropping Windows arm64 if any C deps exist. (6) Separate build jobs from release job in CI to avoid duplicate releases. (7) Always use -trimpath for reproducible builds.
